name: ElectromagneticWave
description: A self-propagating transverse wave of oscillating electric and magnetic fields that travels through vacuum or matter at the speed of light, carrying energy and momentum without requiring a material medium.

chronology.summary: The concept of electromagnetic waves emerged from the unification of electricity and magnetism by James Clerk Maxwell in the 1860s, who predicted their existence. Heinrich Hertz experimentally generated and detected radio waves in 1887, confirming Maxwell's theory. Later developments included the discovery of X-rays by Röntgen (1895), gamma rays by Villard (1900), and the quantum formulation by Einstein (1905) and others, leading to wave-particle duality.

events.event: Maxwell publishes 'A Dynamical Theory of the Electromagnetic Field', predicting electromagnetic waves.
events.associatedContext: Unification of electricity, magnetism, and light; wave equation derived.

events.event: Hertz experimentally generates and detects radio waves, confirming Maxwell's prediction.
events.associatedContext: First controlled production and measurement of electromagnetic waves in the laboratory.

events.event: Einstein explains the photoelectric effect using light quanta (photons), introducing wave-particle duality.
events.associatedContext: Quantum nature challenges purely classical wave ontology.

relationships.description: An electromagnetic wave is composed of oscillating electric and magnetic fields mutually inducing each other.
The behavior of electromagnetic waves is formalized by Maxwell's equations in vacuum or media.
Electromagnetic waves produce radiation pressure and momentum transfer upon absorption or reflection.

specific.conceptEvaluationNote: The electromagnetic wave is a highly successful ontic concept in classical physics, enabling precise predictions of propagation, interference, and radiation. However, at quantum scales it is supplanted by the photon field description, though classical waves remain a valid approximation for many phenomena (coherent states). As an epistemic tool, it provides an intuitive visualizable model but must be complemented by quantum field theory for completeness.

categoryAmbiguity.primaryJustification: Electromagnetic wave is a fundamental ontic entity in classical electromagnetism, directly referring to a real physical phenomenon, not an epistemic artifact or process.

metadata.sourceReference: Derived from Maxwell's equations, standard electrodynamics textbooks (e.g., Jackson, Griffiths), and historical analysis.

name: Quarry
description: An open bedrock excavation read as a natural system: stepped bench faces, quarry floor, talus, intercepted groundwater, dust plume, and colonizing biota — the observer-independent furniture that remains when extraction machinery, firm, and market are set aside.
longDescription: Meso-level segment. Cut includes the rock body, its worked landform, water, air, and pioneer organisms; excludes the extraction plant (technical reading) and the operating organization and product markets (social/production readings), which decompose under their own grammars. Decomposed per 'How to decompose any natural instance?' (Philosophia Naturalis et Operis); long-form decomposition lives in the note corpus at nature/quarry.md.

chronology.summary: Quarries follow bedrock outcrop discovery, bench opening, deepening with dewatering, and eventual abandonment with flooding and ecological succession.

categoryAmbiguity.primaryJustification: Default root is natural (Natural System): the affirmed furniture is observer-independent rock, water, and life. Readable as technique (quarrying methods) and as production facility (operated site with aggregate products); those readings decompose under their own grammars per the multi-root forest rule and are kept as cross-link prose, never merged.

metadata.sourceReference: Philosophia Naturalis et Operis decomposition; note nature/quarry.md.

name: Nature
description: The whole of observer-independent reality: all natural systems, constituents, living organization, processes, phenomena, quantities, and constraints across the physical, chemical, biological, and earth domains.
longDescription: Macro-level root segment binding (root) -> <<Natural Element>> as Complex System. Cut includes every piece of reality at every level of organization; excludes epistemic scaffolding (epistemica), transformation methods (technical reading), and actors/institutions/markets (social reading), which decompose under their own grammars. Long-form decomposition lives in the note corpus at nature/nature.md; child notes earth.md, earth-material.md, mineral.md expand its regions.

chronology.summary: No single origin: the segment covers all of natural history. Child instances carry their own chronologies.

relationships.description: Nature contains Earth as its inhabited-planet subsystem; Earth's full decomposition lives in its own node and note.
Nature contains Natural Material as the totality of untransformed matter; its biogenic/abiogenic split lives in its own nodes and notes.

categoryAmbiguity.primaryJustification: Default root is natural (Complex System): the affirmed furniture is observer-independent. Readable as technique (methods transforming/measuring nature), as social (actors/institutions around natural bodies), and as epistemic (models/standards about nature); those readings decompose under their own grammars per the multi-root forest rule and are kept as cross-link prose, never merged.

metadata.sourceReference: Philosophia Naturalis et Operis decomposition; note nature/nature.md.

auditTrail.reviewNote: Root nature node: all observer-independent reality. Archetype, not a named site.

name: Earth
description: The inhabited rocky planet read as a natural system: iron core, silicate mantle, crust, ocean, atmosphere, and biosphere with plate-climate-weathering-life feedbacks.
longDescription: Macro-level segment, child of nature-ontic-001. Cut includes the body, its envelopes, and resident organisms; excludes launch/sensing/drilling systems (technical reading), states/firms/markets (social/production readings), and models/standards (epistemic scaffolding). Long-form decomposition lives in the note corpus at nature/earth.md.

chronology.summary: Accretion and differentiation, magma-ocean solidification, late bombardment, ocean and atmosphere formation, oxygenation, plate-tectonic and biospheric co-evolution.

relationships.description: Earth is the inhabited-planet subsystem of Nature.
Earth's crust and surface are composed of earth materials (rock, sediment, soil).

categoryAmbiguity.primaryJustification: Default root is natural (Natural System): the affirmed furniture is the observer-independent planet. name: NaturalAbiogenic
description: All physical matter not made by life: minerals, rocks, sediments, soils, natural waters, and air — stuff-kinds individuated by composition, structure, and phase behavior.
longDescription: Meso-level segment archetyped by limestone, child of earth-ontic-001 and natural-material-ontic-001, composed of mineral-ontic-001 kinds. Entered via the composition spine (Natural Object -> Building Block -> Substance / Matter): a limestone bed is the building-block occurrence, the abiogenic material is the substance-kind. (Local file keeps the stable name earth-material for link continuity; the canonical human term is Natural Abiogenic.) Long-form decomposition lives in the note corpus at nature/earth-material.md.

chronology.summary: Aggregates follow crystallization, deposition, burial, diagenesis/lithification, deformation, uplift, weathering, and soil formation.

relationships.description: Abiogenic materials compose Earth's crust, waters, and atmosphere.
Natural Abiogenic is the non-living branch of Natural Material.
Abiogenic aggregates are composed of mineral kinds (e.g. limestone of calcite).

categoryAmbiguity.primaryJustification: Default root is natural (Substance / Matter): the affirmed furniture is observer-independent aggregate. name: NaturalMaterial
description: The totality of untransformed matter: every observer-independent substance no purposeful agent has intentionally worked — minerals, rocks, sediments, soils, waters, air, and all products of life.
longDescription: Macro-level super-kind segment, child of nature-ontic-001, binding (root) -> <<Natural Element>> as Substance / Matter. First cut below intention: origin-agnostic (biogenic and abiogenic alike), composition-free, level-spanning. Splits into biogenic-material-ontic-001 (made by life) and earth-material-ontic-001 (not made by life); all worked matter falls outside it into the technical reading. Long-form decomposition lives in the note corpus at nature/natural-material.md.

chronology.summary: No single origin: covers all of natural substance history. Child instances carry their own chronologies.

relationships.description: Natural Material is the untransformed-matter totality within Nature.

name: NaturalBiogenic
